title: Rory and the Sleepy Willow Valley
verses:
When the sun drifted down past the edge of the hill,
All the leaves in the trees were so quiet and still.
Rory walked through the grass as the shadows grew deep,
And he smiled at the world as it drifted to sleep.

Tilly sat by the stream with a gentle, slow sigh,
Watching purple and pink in the evening sky.
Benny rested his head where the soft clover grew,
As the petals were kissed by the cool night-time dew.

Ricky curled near a tree and let out a big yawn,
Feeling ready to rest as the daylight was gone.
Nia swooped from above with a hum in her chest,
And she landed nearby in a shadowy nest.

Psittaco tucked his nose in a soft leafy bed,
With a blanket of fern to cover his head.
Rory picked out a place where the moss felt so sweet,
And he curled in a ball at the tall willow's feet.

Every star in the sky gave a comforting glow,
While the wind through the trees was all whispery-slow.
Benny closed both his eyes in the peaceful moonlight,
As the valley was wrapped in the cozy blue night.

Ricky snuggled up close right at Tilly’s warm side,
While the moonlight shone down on the valley so wide.
Rory rested his head as the world went to sleep,
Safe and warm in a dream that was peaceful and deep.
